reason: Locked e2e/hint-observed.spec.ts (written under TASK-8.1 fix r1; locked by TASK-8.2 and TASK-9.2) fails 4/4 in Chromium (passes in WebKit). After hand 1 it does `if ((await deal.count()) > 0) await deal.click()` right after the result appears. The Deal next hand button has always rendered one React render after the result (Table's onHandComplete calls setReview from useTableSession's passive effect, so that update gets default priority and renders in a later task). Until now the main-thread grading at hand end (handWrite -> decisionRecord x4 plus userReviewEntries x4) blocked the page long enough that the button was already there when Playwright looked. AC#7 / SPEC-09 remove that main-thread work, so the check now runs in the gap, sees 0 buttons, never clicks, the review holds the next hand, and advanceToHand(2) gives up after 400 slices. The product timing is unchanged (A-2: hold and Deal next hand start at hand end exactly as today).
evidence: Full suite: 235 passed, 1 failed ([chromium] e2e/hint-observed.spec.ts:59 'advanceToHand: hand 2 not dealt after 400 slices'). --repeat-each 4: chromium 4 failed, webkit 4 passed. Error-context page snapshot shows 'Hand over', the 'Deal next hand' button and the 'Hand #1 review' panel all present (never clicked). A temporary probe (deleted) logging the button count every 100 ms real after playToResult returned printed 0, 1, 1, 1, 1: the button appears ~1 render later.
options: Recommended: unlock e2e/hint-observed.spec.ts and wait for the button instead of probing it once, e.g. replace `if ((await deal.count()) > 0) await deal.click();` with `await expect(deal).toBeVisible(); await deal.click();` (hand 1 always opens a review: the user checks/calls to the result). One-line edit, all other assertions unchanged.

Alternative: keep the probe but poll a few fake slices for the button before deciding (e.g. `await runUntil(page, async () => (await deal.count()) > 0, { maxFakeMs: 500 }).catch(() => undefined)`), also a locked edit.

Not recommended: change the product so Deal next hand renders in the same commit as the result (e.g. derive the held review in Table's render from the done table instead of setting it from onHandComplete). It is a refactor of TASK-9.1/9.2 behaviour outside this spec's scope.
